trust_decision.summary: Decided at the single b64 sink: a src may be opened only when the resolved absolute filename is a child of the configured root (base_path, or root_path when set), for every src form (relative, absolute, file://, Windows drive, URL-shaped); at the pinned commit nothing enforces this before open(file_name, 'rb').

landing_point.why: The advisory says reads outside base_path; the only place base_path is applied is the os.path.join at line 80 (absolute paths take line 77-78), reached from RE_TAG_HTML (line 42) -> repl (line 106) -> repl_path (line 68), and the read happens six lines later at line 86.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue that absolute, file:// and Windows-drive sources are not 'relative links' anchored at base_path (docs/src/markdown/extensions/b64.md:39) and leave the is_absolute branch at pymdownx/b64.py:77-78 unguarded.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A relative source containing '..' that normalizes back inside base_path must still be embedded, absolute/file:// image sources were documented as supported, and query-string cache busters must still resolve; an over-broad fix that rejects any '..', any absolute path or any URL drops these.

O6_input_shapes: relative traversal '../extensions/_assets/bg.png' (outside base_path, must be blocked) versus '../test_extensions/_assets/bg.png' (normalizes back inside, must still embed) - pymdownx/b64.py:80
absolute POSIX path '/etc/x.png' via the is_absolute branch - pymdownx/b64.py:77-78

URL-shaped src that is still opened locally: 'http://h/../../x.png' stays is_absolute False with path '/../../x.png', so normpath(join(base_path, path)) escapes through the absolute component - pymdownx/b64.py:73-80
HTML-entity encoded traversal such as '../x.png' decoded by html.unescape inside parse_url - pymdownx/util.py:138
percent-encoded traversal such as '%2e%2e/x.png' decoded by url2path/url2pathname - pymdownx/util.py:70-73
query-string cache busters '_assets/bg.png?v2' where the query is split off before resolution - tests/test_extensions/test_b64.py:53-60

O8b_injection_room.sibling: srcset / multi-candidate attributes: add 'srcset' to RE_TAG_LINK_ATTR and check every comma-separated candidate plus descriptor against the root.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RE_TAG_HTML already matches the whole img attribute block (pymdownx/b64.py:42-54) and only the attribute-name regex in RE_TAG_LINK_ATTR excludes srcset; responsive images are a natural feature for an image-embedding extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: <picture><source src> tags: widen the tag alternative beyond 'img'; the same base_path resolution and open() sink are reused unchanged.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The regex already captures the tag name as a group and RE_TAG_LINK_ATTR then handles any src inside it, so adding 'source' is a one-word change a maintainer could plausibly make.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a data-URI/inline-assets mode in pathconverter that reuses repl_absolute's parse_url + join resolution and then reads the file itself.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pathconverter already resolves img/href paths with the same util.parse_url/url2path primitive (pymdownx/pathconverter.py:72,102) and shares the tag-attribute regex shape, so a maintainer could add the read there instead of in b64.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third consumer of the same containment idiom where the check is copied once more (the b64 guard is visibly copied from this function).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's comment at fix.diff:52-57 is copied verbatim from pymdownx/snippets.py:171-177, showing the maintainer's established pattern of duplicating this check into each file-reading extension.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal / arbitrary local file read through markdown image src

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10 (pyproject.toml:12), hatchling build backend (pyproject.toml:1-5), Markdown>=3.6 and pyyaml (pyproject.toml:25-28); tests via run_tests.py and pytest (pyproject.toml:137-178), no compiled extensions
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_extensions/test_b64.py (TestB64, 4 cases: script/comment avoidance, relative embedding, cache busting, non-existent file:/// path) and tests/test_targeted.py:TestUrlParse for the path-shape parser

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Deny src strings containing '..' or starting with '/' with a raw-string test before util.parse_url, guarding only the relative-join branch.

out_of_scope_notes: Sibling advisory Snippets 10.21.3 (base-path traversal, docs/src/markdown/about/changelog.md:13-14) is already fixed at the pinned commit (pymdownx/snippets.py:171-177) and is not part of this b64 advisory.
pymdownx/pathconverter.py:72-121 also resolves img/href paths against base_path but only re-emits a URL/path and never reads the file, so it does not reach this advisory's protected sink.
unverified: Repository size in MB (repo_mb) could not be measured without a shell, so tiny_repo/giant_repo could not be judged.

The published guard uses os.path.abspath, not os.path.realpath, so a symlink inside the root still escapes; whether hidden tests treat symlink escapes as in scope is unknown and was not counted as an O8 route.
Whether the benchmark's hidden tests exercise the new root_path/restrict_path config options (fix.diff:100-115) or only the default restriction; the report summary names only base_path.
Module-level repl/repl_path are importable and could be counted as extra entry points, but they are undocumented internals reachable only through the extension, so O1 was counted as 1.
